text:
mira: quick post-incident idea — can we prototype an "auto-impact draft" that the incident bot posts after a page? basically: brief customer impact estimate + suggested postmortem template prefilled. saves triage time and makes handoffs cleaner.

ops-bot: auto-summaries are available for incidents with severity >= P1. current summary fields: `summary`, `start_time`, `affected_services`, `current_status`, `pg_count`. need to wire SLA impact calc. :gear:

sam: love this. two quick asks: 1) keep the bot draft editable (not final) and 2) include a short checklist for handoff (who's owning follow-ups).

jay: we can compute immediate customer impact using error-rate * #users baseline and map to impact buckets (none/minor/major/critical). have a small script that estimates impacted customers from request logs — can plug that into bot.

maria: I'll take dashboard integration work — add a collapsible "incident impact" panel on the postmortem dashboard that links to the bot draft and action board. timeline: can ship a basic panel in 2 sprints if we scope to P1/P2 only.

erin: heads-up: if we include any customer-identifying counts in the bot message we need to scrub account IDs and route to private channels only (privacy + sales-led customers). also: audit log requirement for any autogenerated content.

dev-bot: prototype template (feel free to copy/modify):

```
Incident auto-impact draft v0.3
- Brief summary: {incident_summary}
- Start: {start_time} • End/Status: {status}
- Services affected: {services}
- Estimated impacted customers: {inferred_count} (bucket: {impact_bucket})
- SLA exposure estimate: {sla_minutes} minutes
- Suggested owners: {oncall}, {product_poc}, {support_lead}
- Immediate follow-ups (starter):
  1) Create postmortem doc (owner: {oncall})
  2) Blocker fix rollout plan (owner: {eng_lead})
  3) Support communication draft (owner: {support_lead})
- Notes: auto-draft generated from logs and page payload; please edit before publish.
```

pagerbot: page payload includes `region`, `service`, `error_rate_pct`, `page_count`, `raw_logs_url`. adding `inflight_sessions` will improve estimate accuracy. sample payload: `{service: auth, err: 6.2, sessions: 12000}`.

mira: great. couple of implementation concerns: - where do we store the draft? (suggestion: ephemeral doc in the incident folder with versioning) - who can edit it? (small edit group = oncall + eng lead + support rep)

sam: storage: create `incidents/{incident_ts}/autodraft.md` and pin a link in the channel thread. edit perms via incident role. also add a tiny UI in Console to accept/overwrite draft for public postmortem.

jay: for the SLA calc i'd like a fallback model: if logs are noisy, use a conservative bucket (don't underreport). also log the estimation confidence in the draft.

maria: agreed on confidence score. UI should show `estimated_impact` + `confidence: low|med|high`. I'll scope panel to show both numbers and link to raw query.

erin: +1 on privacy and audit. add a one-click "redact" that removes identifiers before the draft goes to a wider channel.

mira: proposed next steps (short):
- sam: create minimal runbook checklist snippet for the draft by EOD Friday (action)
- jay: push an estimator script PR and example payloads (WIP) by Tues (action)
- maria: wire dashboard stub and link to ephemeral docs in next sprint (action)
- erin: draft privacy guidance for auto-drafts (action)

sam: I'll add the runbook snippet here as a starting point: `Handoff checklist: 1) Confirm impact bucket 2) Assign owners 3) Create postmortem doc 4) Open action board 5) Notify customers (if required)`

dev-bot: small CLI to create the autodraft (example):
```
redwood-incident create-autodraft --ts {thread_ts} --payload /tmp/page.json --out incidents/{thread_ts}/autodraft.md
```

mira: love it. can we also experiment with an "auto-schedule" for a 3-day postmortem meeting if the impact is major/critical? the bot could suggest times based on oncall calendar heuristics.

jay: calendar heuristics are doable. prefer to suggest times, not auto-schedule. also include optional "urgent" tag for immediate follow-ups.

maria: volunteer to own the calendar suggestor proof-of-concept (POC). small note: integrating calendar API will require an app approval + scope review.

erin: sounds like a solid plan. please make sure we capture consent for any automated messages that go outside the oncall channel.

mira: thanks all — putting these actions in the incident actionboard now. I'll follow up with a short RFC for the autodraft format and a pilot plan (P1 incidents for 6 weeks). :rocket:
